planets.name: WASP-16 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-16 with a 3.12-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-16 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-16. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.11860349, pl_radj 1.22, pl_bmassj 1.24

quotes.title: WASP-16b
quotes.card: WASP-16b is an extrasolar planet that travels around its star, WASP-16, every 3.12 days.
